fullTextZH: 有一次，我旅行的时候没有住饭店。
fullTextEN: Once, when I was traveling, I didn't stay at a hotel.
I stayed at someone else's house.
This person is not my friend.
I don't know him.
I slept on the sofa at his house.

fullTextZH: 哈喽，我是来自台湾的西卡。
fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.
How are you?
Do you know?

fullTextZH: 在Airbnb以前，有一个Couch Surfing（沙发冲浪）。
fullTextEN: Before Airbnb, there was Couch Surfing.
That is when you travel,
you don't stay at a hotel,
you stay at someone else's house.
This person is not your friend,
you don't know him.
So how is it different from Airbnb?
Airbnb requires payment.
Using Couch Surfing,
you don't need to pay,
it is free.

fullTextZH: 有一次，我去波兰旅行的时候，
fullTextEN: Once, when I traveled to Poland,
It's just using couch surfing.

fullTextZH: 我用这个网站找到一个波兰人，
fullTextEN: I used this website to find a Polish person,
He said I could stay at his place.
His family includes him, his wife,
two people, and a cat.
They invited me to their home,
They are the hosts,
I am the guest.

fullTextZH: 白天的时候，主人要工作，
fullTextEN: During the day, the hosts have to work,
so I go out to have fun alone.

fullTextZH: 那晚上的时候，我们都回家，
fullTextEN: Then in the evening, we all return home,

fullTextZH: 我们一起吃饭、聊天、喝红酒，
fullTextEN: We eat, chat, and drink red wine together,
and play board games.
What are board games?
Board games are games on the table.

fullTextZH: 你和两个人、三个人，或很多人一起玩。
fullTextEN: You play with two people, three people, or many people.
There are many, many types of board games.

fullTextZH: 我的主人有很多很多桌游。
fullTextEN: My hosts have many, many board games.
They have a room,
all filled with board games.

fullTextZH: 他们说，他们不常常旅行，
fullTextEN: They say they don't travel often,
They rarely travel,

fullTextZH: 他们没有去过别的国家，
fullTextEN: They have never been to other countries,

fullTextZH: 可是他们常常请外国人来家里，
fullTextEN: But they often invite foreigners to their home,
Chat with them,
Play board games.

fullTextZH: 这是他们认识世界的方法。
fullTextEN: This is how they get to know the world.
So we

fullTextZH: 我和我的主人还一起做什么呢？
fullTextEN: What else do my host and I do together?

fullTextZH: 他们也带我去朋友家看电影。
fullTextEN: They also take me to friends' houses to watch movies.
You might think,

fullTextZH: 去朋友家看电影有什么特别呢？
fullTextEN: What's so special about watching movies at friends' houses?
What's there to talk about?

fullTextZH: 因为他们的朋友家有一个小电影院，
fullTextEN: Because their friend's house has a small cinema,
With very large, very comfortable chairs,
One chair per person,
And a very large screen,
You can watch movies,
Very cool.
The most special thing is,
Every time they finish watching a movie,

fullTextZH: 他们会聊聊关于影片的东西。
fullTextEN: they talk about things related to the movie.

fullTextZH: 他们不聊很简单、很无聊的问题，
fullTextEN: They don't talk about simple, boring questions,

fullTextZH: 比如影片里的人帅不帅、
fullTextEN: like whether the people in the movie are handsome,
or pretty.
They talk about more difficult,
questions that require long thinking,
for example: Are you afraid of death?

fullTextZH: 你心里最害怕的东西是什么呢？
fullTextEN: What is the thing you fear most in your heart?
Questions like these.
I find it very special,

fullTextZH: 很有趣，因为他们问我这些问题，
fullTextEN: very interesting, because they ask me these questions,
and talk to me about these things,

fullTextZH: 好像他们认识我很久一样。
fullTextEN: as if they have known me for a long time.
Now, when I think of this trip,
I still feel, oh,
I really like it.

fullTextZH: 我非常感谢我的波兰主人。
fullTextEN: I am very grateful to my Polish hosts.

fullTextZH: 他们让一个不认识的人
fullTextEN: They let a stranger
me, stay at their home for a week.
I am very lucky,
to find a very good owner,
nothing bad happened.

fullTextZH: 你觉得这种旅行方法怎么样呢？
fullTextEN: What do you think of this way of traveling?
Have you tried it before?
Do you want to try it?
If there is a person,
who is not your friend,
you don't know him,
would you let him sleep at your house?

fullTextZH: 请你留言告诉我你的故事哦！
fullTextEN: Please leave a message and tell me your story!
See you next time, bye!
